Stone City Farm | Tenino, WA Stone City Farm was founded in 2015 by a retired veteran family with “Texas roots,” whose mission is to create all-natural, high quality, hand-crafted products on our farm located in Tenino, Washington. With a goal to getting back to basics, our family developed our flagship product – all-natural goat milk soap, free of chemicals and preservatives.
